order.caption: Mount rear and front bearings on shaft in cylindrical housing, retain with lock nuts and end caps with oil seals
Attach case bracket to housing and case plate with labyrinth ring and seal ring housing
Fit shaft sleeve, fixed seal and impeller on shaft end, install movable seal retainer on push rods
Install push rod housing, springs, yoke, spider, actuator and weights for centrifugal seal actuation
Close volute case over impeller and support housing on base pedestal
